name: ARC, Circle of Repose, and wildlife

circle-artificer.name: Artificer
circle-artificer.description: Repairs living constructs such as Briar Rams

circle-briar-ram.name: Briar Ram
circle-briar-ram.description: Slow, tough living construct. Batters buildings with heavy strikes; weak against troops.

circle-thornspire.name: Thornspire
circle-thornspire.description: Tough living defense with shorter range and heavy bolts

circle-construct-nursery.name: Construct Nursery
circle-construct-nursery.description: Grows Briar Rams and trains Artificers

arc-relay-station.name: Relay Station
arc-relay-station.description: Extends connected construction support; provides no infrastructure slots

circle-cultivator.name: Cultivator
circle-cultivator.description: Tends living buildings and cultivates renewable Lifebloom

circle-heartgrove.name: Heartgrove
circle-heartgrove.description: Circle headquarters for growth and repair

circle-conservatory.name: Lifebloom Conservatory
circle-conservatory.description: Receives Lifebloom from any number of Cultivators

arc-demolition-trooper.name: Demolition Trooper
arc-demolition-trooper.description: Fragile, slow-firing infantry. Outranges basic defenses and deals bonus damage to buildings; needs protection from troops.
